scope: Read-only static source/reference audit of all25 produced Tripo props and all environment builders. No runtime screenshots/playthrough/API submissions/repairs. Full file vs targeted reads disclosed below.

findings.finding: S04 military truck and transfer bus remain primitive. PROP-VEH-TRANSPORT is only an off-boundary background prop in S05/S06/S07. Architecture binding has no workers branch.

All plot carts remain createPatientCart: role=cart explicitly returns no character asset; static medical spare trolley is unrelated. This includes actual patients in medical beds, damaged-wheel swap, rescue stretchers and supply cart.
Door/lock/fan/brace/cargo/lunch production exists but gameplay paths still update primitive nodes. Static placement adapter has no fact/animation or actor linkage.

25 assets referenced does not mean all scenes covered. Only frontgate/transfer/flank, medical and epilogue have scene prop placements. childhood/mainhall/nightshift/workers/escort/relief/rescue and legacy scenarios return [].

Only7 unique Tripo IDs participate in fallback replacement; remaining18 are dressing/background only. Three front scenes reuse the same placement list. Shelf equipment is not worn equipment. S11 mug deliberately leaves original vessel visible, and west cabinets are untouched.

Missing slot/load/bounds mismatch retains procedural fallback; grouped four machinery models swap atomically only after all load. Level ready collects errors rather than requiring zero errors; UI explicitly reports retained temporary models. Not proof these failures occurred in runtime.

GeneratedSceneAssets has no distance/whitebox LOD or per-frame visibility controller. Off-boundary transport/door can be distant/occluded; visual accessibility not proven here. Explicit generated architecture LOD never re-enables its whitebox target, so those LODs must not be blamed for still-primitive vehicles. Background foundations are newly created BoxGeometry.

Front environment retains original procedural distant crane while catalog and architecture add generated cranes at separate off-map positions. These are separate silhouettes, not proven exact overlap; cannot count added cranes as replacement of the old crane.
